[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.1016/j.cell.2023.05.004.svg)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2023.05.004)

This repository is a fork of the respository published with ["Temperature-dependent RNA editing in octopus extensively recodes the neural proteome" by Birk et al.] from containing the code and original data behind "Temperature-dependent RNA editing in octopus extensively recodes the neural proteome" by Birk et al. Most figures in the paper can be reproduced here.


Octopus drawings are reproduced, with permission, from Roger Hall.

## Setup

```{r Setup}
#| include: false
# load libraries
library(Biostrings)
library(dplyr)
library(colorspace)
library(ggplot2)

root <- here::here()
```


## Figures

Figure 1 

```{r Fig1B}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1B: A large proportion of the *O. bimaculoides* editome exhibits increased editing at colder temperature (blue), but only 789 sites show a significant increase in warm samples (red)."

source(file.path(root, 'scripts', 'make_Fig1B.R'))
```


```{r Fig1C}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1C: Cold-induced increases in editing levels were both more common and higher in magnitude than warm-induced increases. See also Figure S1. Octopus drawings are reproduced, with permission, from Roger Hall."

source(file.path(root, 'scripts', 'make_Fig1C.R'))
```

Figure S1 also goes with these figures


```{r FigS1}

source(file.path(root, 'scripts', 'make_Fig1C.R'))
cowplot::plot_grid()
```
